race.comment: WHO I THINK I AM (9) looks a solid each way hope in an open race. Her sixth at Kyneton came in a BM66 over 1856m on heavy ground, and she is better assessed on the Warrnambool maiden win prior. Blinkers go on here and this looks a nice option. GIRT BY SEA (6) is lightly raced and progressive, having followed a Kilmore debut second with a St Arnaud maiden win as odds-on favourite. Harder now but can't knock. ASEVENTY SEVEN (2) has the established mile credentials and looks suited coming back in trip from 2050m here last time. DUKE OF CLARENCE (5) resumes. He got out over further last time in but kicks off at a good trip and can be running on late.
